create_instances_from_annotations: create an Instances object from dataset annotations with point coordinates and labels for point-supervised detection
subsample_point_annotations: subsample point annotations to a fixed number of points per instance using random sampling
transform_instance_annotations: apply geometric transforms to box and point annotations of a single instance including coordinate mapping
filter_out_of_boundary_points: filter out-of-boundary points after transforms and set their labels to unlabeled
review_annotations_to_instances: review the annotations_to_instances function that converts annotation dicts into model-ready Instances with point supervision fields
